plan.title: Single-stage RFQ vendor accepts both clauses

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure clauses are not automatically mandatory.
Enable creation of the required event flow.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publishing.
Set the requested delivery location.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions on the single-stage RFQ create screen, add clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set the first clause to Required and leave the second clause as None, click Done, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the event-wise terms because no dedicated catalog step edits clause rows and their modes.
Confirm terms configuration returned to the create screen without an error.
Add one QA test vendor for the submission.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional clause is also shown to the vendor.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause.
Quote 100 for the line and submit with both clauses accepted.
Assert that the vendor bid was successfully submitted.
